personal.name: Abimanyu Jayaganesh
personal.headline: CS Engineer & Creative Technologist specializing in Physics-Informed ML, Data Systems, and GPU-Accelerated Pipelines

education.degree: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering

highlights: Designed and evaluated a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) digital twin for EV battery thermal state estimation using PyTorch, Simulink, and ODE-based physics constraints across 522 trajectories and 78M+ time steps.
Reduced unseen WLTP2 autoregressive rollout MAE by 31.2% and maximum error by 65.6% through physics-loss regularization, input noise injection, and GPU-accelerated training with AMP/TF32.
Engineered a full-stack online learning platform using Spring Boot, MySQL, and MongoDB, developing REST APIs and asynchronous data synchronization.
Maintained Grade-A SonarQube quality across 1.6k LOC with 1.8% duplication while applying layered architecture and Agile development practices.
Built a Django-based IoT monitoring platform on AWS EC2, integrating MQTT for real-time device communication and reducing infrastructure costs by 1.5×.
Optimized the RMS data-processing pipeline for high-frequency sensor data, achieving 10× faster visualization and contributing to 3 approved POCs.

projects.title: RetailSink: Real-Time Data Engineering Pipeline
projects.summary: Architected an end-to-end retail analytics lakehouse using DuckDB, Delta Lake, FastAPI, and React, implementing Medallion Architecture and SCD Type 2 tracking across 4+ retail data sources.
key_features: Medallion Architecture (Bronze raw ingestion -> Silver cleansed/conformed -> Gold aggregate analytics)
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD Type 2) tracking for historical auditability
Sub-second OLAP queries powered by vectorized DuckDB over Parquet/Delta Lake format

projects.title: OpenDesign Open Source Contribution
projects.summary: Contributed production-grade deployment infrastructure enabling one-click deployment of generated applications to Netlify, Render, and Railway directly from the platform UI.
key_features: Automated GitHub repository provisioning with OAuth app authorization
Cryptographic deploy-key workflows and repository webhook orchestration
Multi-provider deployment state machine across Netlify, Render, and Railway

projects.title: Frame Order Restoration System
projects.summary: Engineered a video reconstruction pipeline using TSP algorithms (Beam Search, 2-Opt) to restore temporal frame order with greater than 99% frame similarity.
key_features: Parallel feature extraction fusing ORB local descriptors, HSV color histograms, and perceptual hashing (pHash)
GPU-accelerated distance matrix calculation using DirectML execution provider
Traveling Salesperson formulation with Beam Search heuristic and 2-Opt local search refinement

projects.title: Emotional Dependency Detection System
projects.summary: Developed an NLP system for quantifying emotional dependency in user-LLM interactions using Sentence Transformers and XGBoost, achieving R^2 ≈ 0.81 on 4,000+ annotated prompts.
key_features: Fine-tuned embedding representations via Sentence Transformers capturing conversational attachment signals
Gradient boosted regression pipeline with engineered psycholinguistic feature vectors
Cross-validated empirical score of R^2 ≈ 0.81 over a multi-annotator dataset of 4,000+ prompts
